title: A Protocol for the Cipher
author: Theo Eastwick
blurb: Tamsin Reyes, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
